title: Atlas GA has slipped with no new date, and customers were promised the festive season
why: GA moved from 15 Sep; no replacement date is recorded anywhere; the CEO herself is unsure it will land in time for customers who were promised v3.
suggested_action: Ask Vikram for a committed GA date and a list of customers who were promised the festive season.

updates.title: Atlas GA is now 15 Dec (moved on 2 Sep), after the festive season customers were promised, with about half the work still open
updates.why: Vikram moved the Jira GA date from 15 Sep to 15 Dec on 2 Sep; the board heard on 6 Oct and the CEO's transcript still says 'festive season'. Jira shows 115 of 233 story points open; finishing by 15 Dec needs roughly 77 points a month against a best month of 42. Git shows steady work, so Jira may be stale: this is a pace warning, not a forecast. Vikram told the CEO 'on track' (T5).
updates.suggested_action: Ask Vikram for the real remaining scope and a committed date, and tell the customers who were promised the festive season before they ask.

title: Backend capacity: two roles paid for but not filled, and hiring is paused
why: Rs 1.77 L advance paid on 30 Jun; no joiner since Feb; hiring paused; the Q2 board update said these hires were to de-risk Atlas.
suggested_action: Decide whether to stop the search (the balance fee) or ring-fence these two roles from the freeze.

updates.title: Both backend roles (Routing and Platform) have been on hold since 12 Aug while Atlas slipped
updates.why: The CFO paused REQ-014 (Routing) and REQ-015 (Platform) on 12 Aug to protect burn; Vikram agreed to 'absorb it'. 8 candidates are in the pipeline and a final round was cancelled. The Atlas GA then moved. Cause and effect are not proven, and the recruiter's advance (Rs 1.77 L) is already paid. Meanwhile the marketing backfill (REQ-016) is open. On 2 Jun Vikram said the 15 Sep date was 'achievable if the two backend hires land by July'; they did not land.
updates.suggested_action: Decide with Meera and Vikram: reopen the Routing role first, or accept the Atlas delay explicitly and tell the customers.

title: The leadership's headline numbers do not agree with each other or with the board updates
why: ARR, burn and headcount are quoted very differently by the CEO, CFO and board documents (e.g. Rs 6.1 Cr vs 'forty-two crore'; Rs 44 L vs 'two point two lakhs'). The board wants 'the number' by March.
suggested_action: Agree one definition and one owner for ARR, burn and runway before the board asks.

title: AWS cost up sharply and still climbing
why: Every monthly bill from Apr to Sep is higher than the one before (+37% overall); the August bill, booked in Sep, is the largest and the biggest single step.
suggested_action: Ask for a cost breakdown separating incident-driven spend from structural growth.

title: Only product marketer is leaving right after the summit
why: Siddharth Mehta (Product Marketing Manager) exited 31 Oct and hiring is paused. I am assuming (A-008) that product marketing owns launch messaging for Atlas; launch material arrives later in the week.
suggested_action: Confirm who owns Atlas launch positioning now.

updates.title: Product marketer has left citing unclear launch timelines; backfill is open but the launch kit handover is unverified
updates.why: Siddharth resigned on 15 Sep (the original GA date), last day 31 Oct, saying he wants 'clearer launch timelines'. He promised to hand over the launch kit. The backfill (REQ-016) has 7 candidates. His reason is a signal about launch timing, not only about him.
updates.suggested_action: Confirm the launch-kit handover was completed and who owns Atlas messaging; read his reason as feedback on launch planning.

title: Payroll control gap: a new joiner was overpaid in February and the query was never visibly closed
why: Proration was missed when someone covered the payroll run; the employee raised it and got 'will check' with no follow-up on record.
suggested_action: Have Meera confirm the correction and add a proration check to the checklist for covered runs.

title: Routing knowledge may sit with one person (unverified)
why: The CEO says Priya 'basically holds the routing thing together'. Only one second-hand source; engineering data is not in yet.
suggested_action: Wait for commit and Jira data before acting; do not treat as established.

updates.title: Atlas work is concentrated in one engineer: about 70% of engine commits and 56% of story points
updates.why: Priya Nair authors about 70% of atlas-engine commits (50% on her company e-mail alone), holds 56% of Atlas story points and every re-routing story, and all late-night and weekend commits. The paused Routing role (REQ-014) is the one that would have shared this. This is about concentration of work, not about anyone's plans.
updates.suggested_action: Decide who else owns the core engine and re-routing, and whether to reopen REQ-014. Ask Vikram about Priya's 1 Sep request to discuss Atlas ownership, which has no recorded reply.

title: Engineering engagement fell from 3.9 to 3.1 in one quarter, the sharpest drop in the company
why: Team of 5, one fewer response, no comments available (team under 6). Deepa told Ananya on 29 Sep and suggested Vikram hold 1:1s that week; nothing shows whether they happened. The CEO's own concern is engineering speed.
suggested_action: Ask Vikram whether the 1:1s happened and what he is seeing. Keep it team-level; do not try to identify individuals.

title: Arjun's request to make remote work permanent has no recorded answer
why: Asked on 18 Sep; no reply in the records (which are a selection of threads). Low cost to answer, and the engineering team is already under strain.
suggested_action: Ask Deepa whether it was answered.

title: A contractor on-call retainer (about Rs 1.4 L a month) runs alongside the paused permanent hires; the August invoice may include a week before the contractor started
why: Day 1 data shows the contractor's first invoice. Day 3 shows a recurring retainer of Rs 1,20,000 + 18% IGST, and conflicting start dates (rota and invoice say 17-18 Aug; Sneha's e-mail and incident log point to the week of 24 Aug).
suggested_action: Ask Vikram when the contractor really started, and whether the retainer is meant to be permanent.

title: Marketing's numbers and finance's numbers still do not reconcile (Rs 14.3 L in the ledger vs 'one point eight')
why: The GL shows Rs 14.27 L across marketing cost centres; Nikhil quotes 'one point eight' with no unit; the CFO says his numbers never match hers. No marketing-side sheet exists.
suggested_action: Ask Nikhil to send the campaign sheet to Meera (the T4 action item) and agree one definition of marketing spend.

title: Planned reporting-line change (marketing to a new CRO) has no name, date or HR record
why: The CEO says marketing moves under a new CRO 'from next month or the month after'. No CRO exists in Keka or the hiring tracker. Marketing is also losing its product marketer and waiting on a launch date.
suggested_action: Confirm the CRO hire, the effective date and who owns the Atlas launch in the meantime.
